name: Giancarlo Bourbon del Monte
original_name: ジャンカルロ･ブルボン･デル･モン
source:
A man so lucky, he goes by the nickname of "Lucky Dog". Outwardly unkempt and rarely seen wihtout a cigarette wedged between his lips, Gian always carries around his absolute favourite food, chewing gum. Laidback, he doesn't care about about his appearance and has poor personal hygiene. Gian is not the type to dwell on the little things, but he does what he has to do efficiently. Involved in the mafia since his youth, Gian has been in and out of jail. In fact, he is so skilled in escaping prison (and so frequently imprisoned), that he regards it as a hobby. 

[spoiler]He appears to be easy to fool, but in actuality, Gian is quite perceptive and sharp. His one critical weakness would be his emotionality. Gian's favourite colour is yellow and his favourite food is gum. In his spare time, Gian likes to listen to the radio or break out of jail. His CR-5 tattoo is located on his left clavicle.[/spoiler]

[Source: [URL=http://www.tennenouji.net/product/03_luckydog1/charactor/index.html]Luckydog 1 official website[/URL].]
